Title: Schema hygiene, migrations, and long-file split
Purpose: Finish the core hardening by improving entity/configuration auditability, synchronizing provider snapshots or migrations, and reducing remaining long-file concentration in the touched process core.
Deliverables: Smaller, easier-to-audit entity/configuration files for the process aggregates touched by this initiative.
Synchronized SQLite and PostgreSQL snapshots/migrations if the model changed.
ReviewQuestions: Are the touched model/configuration files easier to audit now?
Are both provider snapshots or migrations coherent?
Did we reduce long-file concentration for the right reasons?
CorrectiveOnFailure: If schema/configuration hygiene is still weak or providers drifted, trigger the workspace/shared-infrastructure corrective playbook before final closure begins.
